description_en: Updates a message route in an edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口更新边缘实例中的消息路由
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-edge-instance-message-routing --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id nF9oXo7kLRWQ00000000 --route-id 123456 --name le_lite1 --topic-filter all --source-type device --source-data '#' --target-type function --target-data 58c46749ac934db3925fe500000000 --target-iot-hub-qos 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEdgeInstanceMessageRouting

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IoT Platform instance:
- Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the instance ID on the **Overview** page in the [IoT Platform console](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/).
- Public instance: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
物联网平台的实例ID：
- 企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在[物联网平台控制台](http://iot.console.aliyun.com/)的**实例概览**页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
- 公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The edge instance ID. On the **Edge Instances** page in the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse pointer over the name of the target edge instance to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the message route. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212633.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 消息路由ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212633.html接口获取
parameters.name: route_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the message route. The name must be 4 to 32 characters in length. Chinese characters and full-width symbols count as 2 characters
parameters.help_zh: 消息路由名称。长度限制为4~32个字符，汉字和全角符号算2个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition for messages. Valid values:
- A specific message topic: Messages from the message source that match the specified topic are sent to the message receiver. For more information about topics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html.
- **all**: All messages from the message source are sent to the message receiver
parameters.help_zh:
消息过滤条件，取值如下：
- 具体消息Topic：表示来自消息源，且符合该消息Topic的消息，会被传给消息接收者。Topic相关信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html。
- **all**：表示来自消息源的所有消息，都会被传给消息接收者
parameters.name: topic_filter

parameters.help_en:
The message source. Valid values:
- **device**: The message is sent by a device.
- **function**: The message is sent by an edge application.
- **IotHub**: The message is sent from the cloud
parameters.help_zh:
消息来源，取值如下：
- **device**：表示消息由设备发出。
- **function**：表示消息由边缘应用发出。
- **IotHub**：表示消息由云端发出
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The data of the message source. The value varies based on the following scenarios:

- If **SourceType** is set to **device**: 
    - If a specific device under a specific product sends the message, the value is in the format of `/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} and {Your_DeviceName} with the actual ProductKey and DeviceName of your device.

    - If all devices under a specific product send the message, the value is in the format of `/{Your_ProductKey}/+`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} with the actual ProductKey of your device.

    - If all devices under all products in the edge instance send the message, the value is `#`.

- If **SourceType** is set to **function**: The value is the ID of the edge application. On the **Application Management** page in the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse pointer over the name of the target application to obtain the ID.

- If **SourceType** is set to **IotHub**: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
消息来源的数据，取值分如下几种情况：

- **SourceType**取值为**device**时： 
    - 如果由指定产品下的指定设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}和{Your_DeviceName}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey和DeviceName。

    - 如果由指定产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/+`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey。

    - 如果由边缘实例中所有产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值为`#`。

- **SourceType**取值为**function**：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。

-  **SourceType**取值为**IotHub**时：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: source_data

parameters.help_en:
The message receiver. The value varies based on the following scenarios:
- If **SourceType** is set to **device**: The value can be **function** or **IotHub**, which indicates that messages sent by a device are forwarded to an edge application or the cloud.
- If **SourceType** is set to **function**: The value can be **function** or **IotHub**, which indicates that messages sent by an edge application are forwarded to another edge application or the cloud.
- If **SourceType** is set to **IotHub**: The value can be **function**, which indicates that messages sent from the cloud are forwarded to an edge application
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收者，取值分如下几种情况：
- **SourceType**取值为**device**时：该参数可取的值为**function**或**IotHub**，表示由设备发出的消息，传给边缘应用或云端。
- **SourceType**取值为**function**时：该参数可取的值为**function**或**IotHub**，表示由边缘应用发出的消息，传给另一个边缘应用或云端。
- **SourceType**取值为**IotHub**时：该参数可取的值为**function**，表示由云端发出的消息，传给边缘应用
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The data of the message accept target. The value varies based on the following scenarios:
- If **TargetType** is set to **function**: The value is the ID of the edge application. On the **Application Management** page in the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover your mouse pointer over the name of the target application to obtain the ID.
- If **TargetType** is set to **IotHub**: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收者的数据，取值分如下几种情况：
- **TargetType**取值为**function**时：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**应用管理**页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。
- **TargetType**取值为**IotHub**时：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: target_data

parameters.help_en:
The quality of service (QoS) level. Valid values:

- **0**: The message is sent only once. The system does not verify whether the message is received by the message receiver.

- **1**: The message is sent at least once until the system receives a response from the message receiver.

> If **TargetType** is set to **IoTHub**, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
服务级别。取值如下：

- **0**：表示消息仅发送一次，不管是否被消息接收者成功接收。

- **1**：表示最少发送一次消息，直至收到消息接收者的返回信息，则停止发送该消息。

> 当**TargetType**为**IoTHub**时，必须传入此参数
parameters.name: target_iot_hub_qos
